execution.dispatcher: Root only, native process_start; no shell or new collector
execution.before_and_after_tool_file_info: Root compares complete path/bytes/SHA256/version/ownership/mode/nlink against the preserved actual tool metadata. Any drift prevents facts qualification.
execution.raw_stdout_handling: Root privately retains full stdout/stderr and exact terminal metadata. Export only this closed projection and exact byte/hash references; no raw unknown unit values, paths, arguments or stderr.
execution.completion_gate: Exact single job, terminal joined, no timeout, complete durable untruncated streams; tool observations stable. Bound overflow or incomplete streams stays unqualified.

systemctl.input_gate: Strict UTF-8 LF property records. Split each record once at its first '='; require each exact requested key once, no unknown/duplicate keys or continuation lines.

public_fields.Id: Must equal the one requested known unit, else expose only length/hash and mark mismatch.
public_fields.LoadState: Literal only from stub, loaded, not-found, bad-setting, error, merged, masked; unknown hash-only.
public_fields.ActiveState: Literal only from active, reloading, inactive, failed, activating, deactivating, maintenance, refreshing; unknown hash-only.
public_fields.SubState: Literal only from running, dead, exited, failed, start-pre, start, start-post, stop, stop-sigterm, stop-sigkill, stop-post, final-sigterm, final-sigkill, auto-restart; unknown hash-only.
public_fields.MainPID: Decimal integer 0..2147483647; compare to the actual prior per-unit observation, reporting equality without adopting a new PID.
public_fields.InvocationID: Empty or exact 32 lowercase hex; compare to actual prior per-unit observation, reporting equality without assuming stability outside the read.
public_fields.FragmentPath: Literal only if exactly one of the three supplied public paths. Otherwise UTF8 byte count/full SHA256 and known_path_match=false; do not adopt an unknown path.
public_fields.DropInPaths: Always full byte count/SHA256. Exact empty string is confirmed no listed drop-ins; nonempty remains private for Root review and requires future individually fixed paths before file access.
public_fields.ExecStart: Full byte count/SHA256, not raw argv. Root privately checks actual executable/arguments and reports exact matches to the four known public binary paths separately. Do not infer complete execution semantics from a substring.
public_fields.User: Empty is manager-default, not root. A decimal UID or literal root may be emitted; other values hash-only. User-manager actor must not be inferred solely from this empty property.
public_fields.Group: Empty is manager-default, not root. Decimal GID or literal root may be emitted; other values hash-only.
public_fields.UnitFileState: Literal only from enabled, enabled-runtime, linked, linked-runtime, alias, masked, masked-runtime, static, disabled, indirect, generated, transient, bad; unknown hash-only.

systemctl.changed_or_unresolved: Record actual mismatches and hashes. Service query success is not current_guard pass, Android readiness, deployed-source identity or deployment authorization.
systemctl.user_manager: Use only the already observed user manager under the configured native host execution identity. A missing user bus is a failure, not permission for sudo, a second manager, guessed XDG variables or retry.

exit_codes.0: dpkg-query reports successful search; still parse every requested path independently.
exit_codes.1: One or more requested patterns have no match; preserve per-path matched/no-match/unresolved outcomes.

dpkg_query.stdout: Only accept exact '<package-list>: <requested-full-path>' records, with suffix equal to one of the seven requested paths. Split at the last ': ' so architecture-qualified package names remain intact.
dpkg_query.multiple_owners: Split the package-list only at literal ', '; every token must match the closed grammar. Keep all owners, never choose one silently.
dpkg_query.no_match: Only a fixed English no-path-found diagnostic whose whole path equals one requested argument establishes that path's no-match observation. Unknown diagnostics and diversion records are length/hash-only and keep the affected path unresolved.
dpkg_query.no_match_not_unmanaged: No dpkg file owner is not proof that the runtime is unmanaged. An independent marker or another installation record can still exist.
dpkg_query.followup: If an exact owner is observed, prepare one separate read-only dpkg-query --show with explicit Package/Architecture/Version/db:Status-Abbrev fields for only the observed package names. No installation, removal, database repair or package mutation.

side_effect_disclosure: These invoke fixed systemctl/dpkg-query host processes. systemctl queries its explicitly selected systemd manager over D-Bus; neither operation calls Droidloom Status/Readiness or Android. They do not claim zero host children.
existing_failures: Ticket pre-install read-only HOST_COMMAND_INTERRUPTED/post-guard UNKNOWN, London launch UNKNOWN and all old source/result history remain unchanged.
